title: Open Special Order Cushion on Ridgeline Consumer Credit Payoff Drafts
content:
**Desk rule.** The fixed draft amount of a Ridgeline Consumer Credit deferred-interest payoff plan carries an open-order cushion set by the customer's open orders with Ridgeline Special Order Services: the balance due on the customer's special orders that are in production, shipped or ready, totalled.

| Balance due on the customer's special orders in production, shipped or ready | Open-order cushion |
|---|---|
| totals 1000.00 or more | 50.00 |
| more than zero but less than 1000.00 | 25.00 |
| none | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The open-order cushion is added to the fixed draft amount once that amount has been rounded up to the whole dollar.

**Records read.** The customer's Ridgeline Special Order Services orders: each order's status and its balance due. Only orders whose status is in production, shipped or ready enter the total; orders in any other status do not.

## Hypothetical cases

| Customer's special orders | Balance due counted | Cushion |
|---|---|---|
| one order in production with 1200.00 due | 1200.00 | 50.00 |
| one order ready with 400.00 due | 400.00 | 25.00 |
| one order shipped with 0.00 due | 0.00 | nothing |
| one order completed with 900.00 due | 0.00 (completed is not in the list) | nothing |

**Hypothetical:** a whole-dollar draft of 200.00 with a 25.00 cushion becomes 225.00.
